name: moodswing9
description: Claude Code plugins for Dell EMC backup infrastructure — PowerProtect Data Manager, NetWorker and Data Domain — plus an AI presentation generator.

plugins.name: networker-ppdm
plugins.description: Expert guidance and automation for NetWorker, PPDM and Data Domain: a knowledge skill, 13 slash commands (health checks, SLA and executive reports, guided restores, DR orchestration and planning, anomaly detection) and 2 agents.

plugins.name: backup-log-analyzer
plugins.description: /analyze-log — severity, root causes and fix commands for PPDM, NetWorker, Data Domain, Veeam, syslog and Windows Event Log output, with a diff mode for regressions.

plugins.name: ppdm-es-troubleshooter
plugins.description: /es-diagnose and /ppdm-check — structured diagnosis of PPDM Elasticsearch problems and live cluster health checks with remediation commands.

plugins.name: ppdm-watch
plugins.description: /ppdm-status — an AI briefing from ppdmwatch daemon logs, plus a skill for interpreting the real-time PPDM monitoring dashboard.

plugins.name: ppdm-capacity-planner
plugins.description: plan-capacity skill — forecasts when PPDM storage systems will cross 80% and 95%, with recommendations and an executive summary. Includes a demo mode.

plugins.name: deck-generator
plugins.description: /deck and /deck-remix — generate or remix PowerPoint and HTML presentations from any topic.
